title: Guardrail: disable buffering/compression for SSE routes (OpenAI compat)
author: maya_srinivasan
description:
Context
- SUP-3091 / INC-2025-0328-stream-hang: us-east streaming hang correlated with edge proxy config rollout.

What
- Add explicit config guardrails for SSE endpoints used by OpenAI-compat:
  - disable response buffering
  - disable compression
  - force chunked flush behavior
- Add startup validation that fails the config if buffering is enabled on known SSE routes.

Why
- Some proxy configurations buffer small chunks, which breaks token streaming and can look like a hang even when the model is generating.

Testing
- Added a config unit test + a lightweight e2e stream test in perf-canary suite.

Rollout
- Merge to main; will be cherry-picked into edge config release after validation in staging.

Review conversation
- david_kim: +1 on failing fast; we should never buffer SSE
- karthik_iyer: also ensure /v1/responses stream=true is covered
- maya_srinivasan: added both paths to the allowlist.
